prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: five-view 2D orthographic spaceship modeling reference for the existing Stellar Syndicates TITAN flagship.

Transform the supplied Titan artwork into ONE polished, consistent reference sheet with exactly FIVE complete views of the SAME ship: FRONT, BACK, TOP, BOTTOM, SIDE. This is a production reference for a later textured 3D model, so the underside and end elevations must be fully resolved.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the authoritative top-down TITAN master. Preserve this ship's recognizable outline, proportions, open spaces, armor language, and equipment placement.
Image 2 is the supporting isometric TITAN artwork, used to understand depth, construction, and materials. Do not copy its perspective.
Image 3 is the CRUISER reference sheet, used ONLY for the sheet layout, white background, drawing style, and labeling. Do not borrow Cruiser geometry.

Titan identity: monumental trident or crown silhouette; one exceptionally long pointed central spear hull projecting well beyond two shorter, heavy forward side citadels; two long, visibly OPEN negative-space channels separating the three prongs; diagonal structural bridges linking the side citadels to a wide armored aft command fortress; raised circular command/reactor assembly near the aft center; layered central dorsal spine; repeated recessed heavy gun batteries distributed along the citadels and aft shoulders, matching the source positions; four large central cylindrical stern drive housings and two flanking auxiliary engine pods. This is the existing enormous flagship, not a fighter or freighter. Convey scale through small maintenance panels, fine windows, layered armor, and heavy structure, without adding other ships.

Composition: generous wide LANDSCAPE canvas, approximately 2:1. Crisp high-resolution drafting suitable for texture and modeling reference. Clean warm-white background. Large TOP and BOTTOM plan views occupy the left half, side by side, nose straight UP, same length and beam. The right half has FRONT across its upper area, BACK below it, and a long SIDE profile at the bottom, nose pointing LEFT. Keep the top/bottom and side lengths consistent; keep front/back beam consistent with the plan views. Exactly five ship drawings, with ample separation and no cropping. Restrained title "TITAN" at upper left. Clear labels "TOP", "BOTTOM", "FRONT", "BACK", "SIDE" beneath the respective views. No other text or dimensions.

Style and surfaces: precise colored hard-surface concept drafting with thin crisp dark contours and gentle neutral shading. Pale titanium and off-white armor plates, charcoal gunmetal structure and inset channels, fine restrained brass edging and hardware, small cyan luminous strips and stern engine interiors. Match the Titan source's lightly worn panel textures, joints, radiator slats, dark recesses, and broad readable armor shapes. No heavy weathering, rust, dramatic lights, or smoke.

Projection and cross-view consistency:
TOP is straight overhead, no yaw/pitch/perspective. Preserve the trident proportions and bilateral symmetry of the source. The negative spaces between prongs are white background, not solid panels. Exhaust cylinders run along the ship's length; their circular rear apertures must not face the overhead camera.
BOTTOM is a true underside view with nose UP and exactly the SAME exterior silhouette, open channels, support positions, and engine placement as TOP. Design a complete distinct ventral surface: segmented belly armor, recessed longitudinal keel, flush service hatches, protected radiator strips, docking/access panels, brass fasteners and subtle cyan service lights. Carry the textures to every edge. No plain untextured belly. Do not copy dorsal turrets or the raised command dome onto the underside. Open structural gaps stay open. No landing gear or new appendages.
FRONT is a level, head-on ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation with zero camera elevation. Fore-aft length collapses. Show the wide shallow layered hull and the corresponding heights of the central spear, side citadels, command structure and visible forward-facing gun ends, with correct occlusion. No top-down trident image squeezed vertically. No rear engine circles visible through the ship.
BACK is level, exactly stern-on, with the same total width and height as FRONT. Show the four large central round cyan exhaust apertures and the two flanking auxiliary engine groups consistently with the top and side. Clear dark nozzle rims and substantial armored aft bulkhead. Forward-pointing weapons show housings from behind, not rear-facing gun barrels. No new vertical stack of large engines.
SIDE is a genuine level orthographic side elevation, nose LEFT, stern RIGHT. Show the long spear's tapered thickness, shorter lateral citadel profile, aft fortress, raised dorsal command structure, small weapon mounts and underslung armor. Engines face RIGHT with longitudinal housings. Features align with the other projections. No diagonal, overhead, or three-quarter view.

Avoid: extra perspective hero views, other ships, cutaways, exploded diagrams, stars, scenery, clouds, floors, long exhaust plumes, thick drop shadows, grid overlays across the artwork, logos, watermarks, extra labels, contradictory geometry or missing underside texture.
